# ReelForge

> Local tool that turns a voice recording and one episode.yaml into finished 1080×1920 vertical explainer videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts): 62 animated components timed to spoken words, English and Arabic (right-to-left) word-by-word captions, sound effects, mastered audio and platform-ready MP4s. No AI in the render engine (deterministic DOM/SVG frames in headless Chromium, encoded by FFmpeg); optional local speech alignment (`reelforge align`, models downloaded once by `reelforge align --setup`, offline afterwards) and scene suggestions. Agents drive it through the `reelforge mcp` server. Apache-2.0; docs at https://terminaldz.github.io/vidcreat, source at https://github.com/TerminalDZ/vidcreat.
